attacker_controls: a remote group-chat participant's bot display name (entry.from.name), rendered via BotFace for remote speakers with no local metadata
attacker_achieves: breaks out of the data-bot-face HTML attribute in blobMarkup's string-built SVG markup and injects a live sibling DOM element (e.g. an img with an onerror handler) into the Electron desktop renderer via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, a DOM-based HTML/script injection
